newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CELTIC GO TOP AS RANGERS SLIP UP AT RAITH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CELTIC GO TOP AS RANGERS SLIP UP AT RAITH.

text.p: Celtic went top of the Scottish premier division for the first time for 14 months on Saturday after they beat Aberdeen 1-0 and champions Rangers were held to a 2-2 draw by bottom club Raith.
A goal from Italian winger Paolo di Canio after 70 minutes gave Celtic their three points. They head the table on goal difference from their city rivals.
Rangers fell behind against Raith, hit back with goals from Dutchman Peter Van Vossen and Scotland striker Ally McCoist, and then conceded a late equaliser by Iain Monroe.
"I'm disappointed to have lost a lead again," Rangers manager Walter Smith said. "In all the matches we've dropped points this season we've been ahead."
Troubled Paul Gascoigne, named in England's squad for the the World Cup qualifier against Georgia next weekend despite allegations of wife beating, had an indifferent game.
Rangers have taken just five points from their last four matches. Their next league game is at Celtic Park.
